breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains the thin-walled closed tube approximation ('Model the shaft as a thin-walled closed tube using the mean-area shear-flow relation to obtain the surface shear stress'), which is the exact inconsistency that needed to be removed. The ground truth drops this thin-walled approximation entirely and relies solely on the exact thick-walled torsion formulas (J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32 and τ = T·c/J). The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
